cohort: 7 patients from one referral center who underwent vaginal cesarean delivery between 2000 and 2017 for urgent premature delivery due to severe maternal indications
finding: Vaginal cesarean delivery was found to be a valuable technique for rapid fetal extraction of deceased or nonviable fetuses in cases of severe maternal indications, with no intraoperative complications attributable to the procedure in this case series.
mod_finding: The study focuses on vaginal cesarean delivery, a surgical technique for rapid fetal extraction.
